ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Matthew 6:5–8 follows Tolstoy's Russian wording with lowercase «отец» (otets, 'father'); in reading 5 «клеть» (klet', 'storeroom'), «божеское начало» (bozheskoe nachalo, 'the divine source'), and «раб бога» (rab boga, 'slave of God') are kept literal rather than the website's 'cell', 'principle', and 'servant'. «Магометане» (magometane) is rendered with the period term 'Muslims'.
